description: eQTL Catalogue adult-brain gene-level eQTL fetch for Sprint-4 colocalisation loci
release_note: r7 = latest release with tabix-indexed TSV sumstats (June 2024; FTP files dated 2023-04-06/2024-05-20). r8 pre-release (/r8_beta/, GTEx v10) is parquet-only and not used.

probe.body_prefix: This API is no longer available. See the eQTL data access documentation: https://www.ebi.ac.uk/eqtl/Data_access/

rest_api.note: deprecated; Data_access page states the RESTful API is no longer available

effect_allele: ALT. beta is per copy of the ALT allele (eQTL Catalogue Data_access FAQ: 'The ALT allele is always the effect allele'; Columns.md: 'alt - GRCh38 alternative allele (also the effect allele)'). ac = ALT allele count, an = allele number; maf is the minor-allele frequency (ALT frequency = ac/an).
duplicate_rows_note: one rsid per row: a variant with several dbSNP-151 rsids is repeated; de-duplicate on (molecular_trait_id, variant) before colocalisation

susie_access.why_no_region_query: lbf_variable.txt.gz and credible_sets.tsv.gz have no .tbi on the FTP; lbf files are plain gzip (not BGZF: gzip FLG byte 0x00, no BC extra field) and rows are grouped by fine-mapped gene with chromosomes interleaved, so a remote region query is impossible; the whole file must be streamed.
susie_access.lbf_columns: molecular_trait_id region variant chromosome position lbf_variable1..lbf_variable10
susie_access.lbf_to_cs: lbf_variableK corresponds to credible-set index L<K> (cs_id <trait>_L<K>) in credible_sets
